Load the example sea-mask raster

Source: R/functions-get_examples.R
get_example_seamask.Rd

Reconstructs and returns the example sea-mask raster supplied with the package.

Usage

get_example_seamask()

Value

A raster::RasterLayer object containing the example sea mask. The returned raster layer is named "seamask_3035".

Details

The example sea mask is stored internally as a list containing:

  • metadata: Raster dimensions, extent, and coordinate reference system.

  • matrix: Raster cell values.

The raster is reconstructed from the stored metadata using the package's internal raster-construction helper and is then populated with the stored cell values.

The returned raster can be supplied as the seamask argument to seabord().

See the package input vignette for an example: vignette("C_KI_inputs", package = "seabORD").

See also

get_example_brddata(), get_example_frgcompdata(), get_example_fltdist_base(), and seabord().

Other example data: get_example_DBS_map(), get_example_ORDpoly(), get_example_fgc_3035(), get_example_fltdist_base(), get_example_frgcompdata(), get_example_modpar(), get_example_ordPar(), get_example_output(), get_example_par(), get_example_spadat1(), get_example_spadat2(), get_example_spdat(), get_example_switches()

Examples

# Load the example sea mask
seamask <- get_example_seamask()

# Inspect the raster
seamask
#> class      : RasterLayer 
#> dimensions : 2200, 1577, 3469400  (nrow, ncol, ncell)
#> resolution : 1000, 1000  (x, y)
#> extent     : 2661966, 4238966, 2685159, 4885159  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> crs        : +proj=laea +lat_0=52 +lon_0=10 +x_0=4321000 +y_0=3210000 +ellps=GRS80 +units=m +no_defs 
#> source     : memory
#> names      : seamask_3035 
#> values     : 0, 0  (min, max)
#> 

# Plot the raster
raster::plot(seamask)
